restraints_config._comment: rgi_utils restraint-guided inference (JAX backend). RUN (partition af3): python run_alphafold.py --run_data_pipeline=False --model_dir=/home/apps/alphafold3/models --json_path=restr_example.json --output_dir=../out_af3_example . MSA is inline (single-sequence) so this is self-contained. NOTE: AF3 rejects unknown JSON keys at the fold-input top level, so usage notes live here inside restraints_config (which AF3 passes through to rgi_utils; '_comment' keys are ignored by the parser). conformer vdw MUST be mode=intramolecular under JAX. AF3's minimizer converges near-target (~24-25 A); the combined distance+conformer uses max_iter=2000. start_sigma: a restraint is active when sigma<=start_sigma; OPTIONAL per distance entry and once in conformer_restraints_config (omit -> active every step); no top-level/global start_sigma.

distance_restraints_config._comment: COM distance pulled to target_distance. type: harmonic{target_distance} | flat-bottomed{target_distance1,target_distance2} | flat-bottomed1 | flat-bottomed2. resid = per-chain 1-based ordinal; qualify protein groups with 'chain A and (...)' so a bare resid range does not also match the ligand (chain B). start_sigma is optional on each distance entry (omit -> every step).
distance_restraints_config.atom_selection1: chain A and ((resid 5 to 84) or (resid 186 to 224))

conformer_restraints_config._comment: Hold the ligand at its ideal RDKit geometry. start_sigma applies to ALL conformer terms (one value, all ligands); lower it to enforce ligand geometry only late in denoising. vdw mode=intramolecular is required for the JAX backend.
